usage: Licensed illustrative stock photos for fictional demos only. These galleries combine architectural and landscape references; they do not document one property for sale, and their photographed locations are not the demo map pins. All covers are different. processing: Covers cropped to 4:3 with the recorded focal position. Remaining photos keep their proportions. Resized, WebP compressed and metadata removed; only exposure adjustments recorded per photo. No AI image generation.
